audit.whatIsWrong: Devour and Abyssal Dive have their slot letters swapped throughout content — real kit is W = Abyssal Dive, R = Devour, but content repeatedly writes "Devour (W)" and "Abyssal Dive (R)". The passive is also fabricated as "Three-course Meal" (real name: An Acquired Taste), and wants.foe[0] is truncated mid-word ("burst-w").
audit.why: Devour is the level-6 ultimate that eats an ally to shield or an enemy to banish; Abyssal Dive is the basic-point W dive/knockup. Swapping them tells the reader the wrong ability is gated behind level 6.
audit.corrected: Swapped the (W)/(R) tags on every Devour/Abyssal Dive mention in content, replaced Three-course Meal with An Acquired Taste, and completed the truncated wants.foe[0] line.

audit.why: phases[].side agrees with content.win[] at every row (Blitzcrank through first item, Skill at 2+ items) and matches the packet levelChart exactly — no chart edit needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Abyssal Dive (W) is 21/20/19/18/17s — the real number for how often his engage/escape is live.
audit.corrected: Added the Abyssal Dive cooldown progression.

edits.after: Skill-based: Tahm's Devour (R) shield-save and Abyssal Dive (W) engage let him flip fights, so late trades come down to whether you Grab him or he eats your carry first.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 favour you: Tahm Kench's only early threat is Tongue Lash (Q), a slow, telegraphed skillshot you can side-step or body-block for your ADC. Threaten Rocket Grab (Q) whenever he steps up, since his poke range is shorter than your hook. At 2 take Overdrive and all-in with Power Fist before his Q stun and Three-course Meal stacks come online. Keep him from landing a free Tongue Lash and he has no way to answer your engage. Punish every overstep hard.

At 2 take Overdrive and all-in with Power Fist before his Q stun and An Acquired Taste stacks come online. Keep him from landing a free Tongue Lash and he has no way to answer your engage. Punish every overstep hard.

edits.before: From 3-6 you keep initiative. Tahm wants to land Tongue Lash to stun and proc his passive burst, but the wind-up gives you time to dodge and counter-Grab. The key read is his Devour (W): he can eat his own ADC to negate the follow-up on a landed hook, so aim your Grab at Tahm himself to strip the protector. Ward the flanks against his roam pressure, and collapse with your ADC when his W is on cooldown. His short range keeps forcing him into your hook zone.

Ward the flanks against his roam pressure, and collapse with your ADC when his W is on cooldown. His short range keeps forcing him into your hook zone.

edits.before: After first item your Grab is up nearly every wave and threatens a pick each time Tahm steps to poke, but the late game turns skill-based. Devour (W) lets him shield-save an ally through your all-in, and Abyssal Dive (R) gives him an engage or peel tool that can flip a fight you thought you won. Static Field (R) still bursts, but a well-timed W negates your combo. The matchup late comes down to target priority: Grab Tahm to disable the save, or bait his W before committing on your ADC's kill.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Overdrive answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
